answer: An identity earns its seat through DNSSEC chain proof for a personal domain, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 754 fakes spends 13572 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One canyon of signal, one nadir of cost, one haven of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
